name: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep
exe: KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep FINAL MIX.exe
notes: Haptics come from the game's own rumble (through the virtual Xbox controller) plus its sound: keyblade hits and magic give crisp taps, big attacks and bosses give deep rumble. Before playing: turn Steam Input OFF for this game. If the game reacts to every button twice, install HidHide and hide the DualSense from the game. Triggers are left free; use the Trigger Lab if you want resistance. Game state: DS5 Forge reads the game's memory (read-only). Birth by Sleep's HP address isn't published, so the first time, open the Game Data tab and run Find HP (takes a minute, then it's saved). After that: hits, healing, low-HP heartbeat and death are felt in the haptics, triggers and lightbar.
